opening.text: I have really bad pain in my right arm. It started three days ago, and the pain started gradually. I stumbled over a toy on the floor and tried to brace myself with my right arm, but I ended up landing on my hand. I believe I can move it in all directions, but it hurts when I do. I am allergic to aspirin. I take Tylenol. I use an albuterol inhaler.
